# Security model

**Verification scope:** see [current status](../guide/status.md). The recorded M2 proof run is **verified on devnet**; integrated flows are **verified on local test validator** with a **fixture / mock provider**. Full devnet agent acceptance lacks complete evidence here. Marketplace acceptance is **not yet run** in this checkout.

Veilo separates agent planning, owner authority, wallet signing, on-chain verification and paid-service delivery. An agent request alone is never sufficient authority to release funds.

## Assessment scope and conclusion

Team self-assessment of source snapshot `fe13778`, reviewed against the recorded evidence on 17 October 2026. M2 demonstrates the proof-based devnet funding rail; local integration reports 30/30 cases with mock inference. Neither establishes live agent inference, a completed submission gate, an independent audit or production safety. Permission tiers below are implemented controls with local test coverage; full devnet agent acceptance is **not yet run**.

Assets include test-token principal, note/signing/encryption secrets, owner authority, provider quota, ledger integrity and private prompts. Threat actors include malicious services/prompts, impersonating workers, replaying/concurrent callers, compromised gateway/relayer/indexer, hostile host access and faulty circuits/setup/program administrators.

## Marketplace threat and authority extension — pending

The accepted v3.2 design adds independent buyers/sellers and Supabase identity/product records while keeping one owner per workspace. Cloud sign-in is separate from the existing local challenge and never releases spending authority. RLS, explicit grants, sanitized public catalogue projections and private participant Storage are required; direct client writes to quote/job/payment/earnings state are prohibited. Service keys stay server-side. These cloud controls are not implemented or tested here.

New threats include cross-tenant reads, forged seller callbacks, payout/version substitution, duplicate receipt attribution, stale workers, malicious result files and compromised hosted execution. The local runner’s restricted tools do not establish a hosted sandbox. The operator/seller/provider can see job content and relationships. [All 14 marketplace acceptance checks](../guide/marketplace-triage.md) remain open; existing CAP/IDEM/REC results are supporting local foundations only.

## Permission tiers

| Mode | Behavior | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Observe | Propose a plan and resource purchases | No spending proof or signature is released |
| Bounded automatic | Execute purchases that satisfy every applicable rule | All task, agent and workspace limits still apply |
| Approval required | Obtain explicit owner approval for a permitted purchase | Approval cannot override hard limits |
| Stopped | Reconcile existing operations | No new spending authority; recovery uses a separate owner-authorized path |

## Enforcement boundaries

| Layer | Security responsibility |
|---|---|
| Owner control | Authenticate actions, bind worker scope, check policy versions and reserve budgets atomically |
| Wallet service | Protect note secrets, generate proofs locally and validate the complete merchant transaction before signing |
| Pool program | Verify proof/context, enforce value conservation, reject reused nullifiers and bind owner exits |
| Gateway | Bind quote/account/request, reconcile settlement, issue credits once and bound provider execution |
| Runner | Use restricted tools; treat retrieved content and service responses as untrusted input |

Budgets and revocation are enforced by owner-controlled services. They are not cryptographic spending caps. The model cannot expand its policy, access secrets, sign arbitrary transfers or authorize external publishing.

## Authentication and secret isolation

Owner sessions require a domain-bound wallet challenge with nonce, expiry and replay protection. Browser mutations require CSRF defenses. Worker credentials bind workspace and agent independently of IDs supplied in request bodies. Control separately validates each supplied task against that agent/workspace; the bearer credential itself is not task-scoped.

Keep note databases, decryption keys, signer material and provider credentials inaccessible to the agent runner. Restrict internal endpoints by credential and process boundary. Do not log private witnesses, authorization headers or secret values.

## Concurrency and recovery

Reserve all applicable allowances and the input note in one control transaction. Keep released proofs and unsettled signatures counted as live exposure. Reconcile an existing operation before issuing replacement authority. Persist payment and service-delivery outcomes separately.

## Administration and setup

The deployment manifest records upgrade, approval and sponsorship authorities. The upgrade authority can replace code; the approved-root authority can restrict private spending. The program has no sweep instruction, and owner public exit does not require approved membership. A common operator can control multiple roles; separate public keys do not prove independent operators. The current deterministic development setup has derivable toxic waste and is for test funds only.

## Verification

A security design describes required behavior; it does not establish that an implementation has passed a security review. Evaluate the [verification requirements](./evidence.md) against the exact application version and deployed artifacts. See [trust and risk boundaries](./risks.md) for residual limitations.

---

# Trust and risk boundaries

**Verification scope:** see [current status](../guide/status.md). The recorded M2 proof run is **verified on devnet**; integrated flows are **verified on local test validator** with a **fixture / mock provider**. Full devnet agent acceptance lacks complete evidence here. Marketplace acceptance is **not yet run** in this checkout.

| Boundary | Risk | Design response |
|---|---|---|
| Owner host and wallet | Compromise exposes notes or bypasses local spending policy | Isolated credentials/processes, constrained signer, encrypted backups with writers quiesced for an operator snapshot |
| Circuits and verifier | Incorrect constraints/encodings can compromise the pool; current deterministic development setup has derivable toxic waste | Devnet test funds only; pinned artifacts and local positive/negative proof tests do not replace a production ceremony or independent review |
| Pool metadata | Small pools and distinctive amounts/timing enable correlation | Explain public information and avoid treating membership size as an anonymity score |
| Program administration | Upgrade authority can change enforcement; approved-root authority can restrict private spending | Disclose powers separately and preserve owner exit without approved membership |
| Released authority | Proofs or signed transactions may settle after a stop | Track live exposure until settlement or proven expiry; recheck before release |
| Gateway and provider | Accounts, requests and prompts permit off-chain linkage | Minimize metadata and retention; authenticate result access; disclose visibility |
| External execution | A settled payment may have an uncertain or missing service result | Persist execution state and cache results; avoid blind provider/payment retries |
| Backup and restore | Lost change or reused wallet material can lose funds or duplicate authority | Wallet/control snapshots are separate and omit the gateway ledger; quiesce writers, retain matching gateway state/credentials and reconcile after restore |
| Dependencies | Devnet, RPC, facilitator or provider outages interrupt work | Health checks, bounded retries/cost and explicit pause states |
| Public exit/recovery | Reveals value or linkage | Use bound owner destinations and explain the public nature of the operation |

Independent review and execution evidence are needed to evaluate implementation safety. Privacy depends on correct cryptography and operational behavior; it does not hide every transaction detail from every observer.

## Submission and licensing

Organizer acceptance of devnet/reuse remains unresolved. Veilo’s own license is an owner decision; GPL prover/hash components and the verifier’s MIT-metadata/Apache-license-file discrepancy require review. See [attribution](../references/attribution.md) and [handoff](../handoff.md).

## Marketplace risks — accepted scope, controls unverified

| Boundary | Required response / current gap |
|---|---|
| Cloud identity and private jobs | Separate marketplace and local sign-in; tenant grants/RLS and private Storage are missing here. Unsigned wallets and other buyers/sellers must have no private access. |
| Cloud-to-local connection | No cloud spending authority; authenticated/digest-bound/expiring outbound connection, acknowledged policies and offline pause still need implementation. |
| Seller recipient and earnings | Current managed gateway has one merchant. Block paid managed listings until per-listing binding, verified finality and one-receipt/one-job/one-earnings uniqueness pass. |
| Delivery and refunds | Direct prepayment provides no escrow or automatic refund guarantee. Paid failures stay visible; seller-funded finalized refunds need destination and cumulative-amount checks. |
| Hosted jobs and connectors | No hosted sandbox/credential broker is established by local process separation. Limit attempts/egress/grants; reject stale leases and forged callbacks; prevent result files executing scripts. |
| Privacy and retention | Operator/sellers/providers see plaintext processed jobs and buyer–seller links. Required 30-day cleanup and signed downloads are unverified; RLS is not metadata anonymity. |

See [marketplace triage](../guide/marketplace-triage.md) for exact closure evidence. Marketplace inclusion and Supabase adoption have already been approved; remaining engineering gates are not reasons to describe them as out of scope.

# Verification requirements

**Verification scope:** see [current status](../guide/status.md). The recorded M2 proof run is **verified on devnet**; integrated flows are **verified on local test validator** with a **fixture / mock provider**. Full devnet agent acceptance lacks complete evidence here. Marketplace acceptance is **not yet run** in this checkout.

Use these acceptance scenarios to evaluate the security and reliability of an implementation. Each result should identify the application version, environment, reproducible scenario, observed behavior and relevant artifacts. The matrix below defines expected outcomes. Recorded coverage is mapped separately; a row alone is not a passing result.

| Case | Scenario | Expected evidence / result |
|---|---|---|
| NET-01 | Mainnet/wrong mint config | Startup and payment reject |
| X402-01 | Exact ordinary payment | Devnet settlement plus real bounded inference |
| X402-02 | Wrong amount/ATA/authority/fee payer/instruction | Complete verifier rejects |
| X402-03 | Same signature on another quote/account | No second fulfilment or credit issuance |
| X402-04 | Same operation with changed request | 409 conflict, no charge |
| PRIV-01 | Valid spend and change | On-chain real proof accepted; change note spendable |
| PRIV-02 | Bad proof/context/public input | No release of value |
| PRIV-03 | Same nullifier twice | Second spend/exit rejected |
| PRIV-04 | Underflow/wrapped values/wrong root | Rejected; no invented balance |
| PRIV-05 | Forged insertion/genesis/duplicate precommitment | Rejected or authenticated queue invariant preserved |
| PRIV-06 | Unapproved original and change owner exit | Private pay rejected when required; valid public exit works |
| PRIV-07 | Multiple labeled test deposits | No explicit spent-deposit identifier in withdrawal; metadata caveats documented |
| CAP-01 | Per-purchase/task/agent/global cap | No proof/signature released beyond any cap |
| CAP-02 | Two agents race for final allowance | Atomic authorization admits only permitted exposure |
| CAP-03 | Uncertain payment crosses rolling window | Reservation still counts |
| CAP-04 | Lower limit below pending exposure | New spend blocked, exposure visible |
| REV-01 | Pause before signing / proof released | New authority blocked; released material handled honestly |
| AUTH-01 | Agent passes another agent ID | Scope mismatch rejected |
| AUTH-02 | Role tries arbitrary sign/policy edit/publish | Tool unavailable or independently denied |
| IDEM-01 | Same logical purchase repeatedly | One financial operation; same state/result |
| REC-01 | Restart at every multi-leg boundary | Notes/keys/credits/reservations restored and reconciled |
| REC-02 | Lost settlement response | Reconcile existing signature; no blind new debit |
| REC-03 | Fresh-wallet recovery conflicting with signed tx | Wait for proven safe outcome; only owner destination |
| CRE-01 | Restart after settle before issue | Issue pack once |
| CRE-02 | Two usage requests over available credits | One bounded outcome; no negative credits |
| CRE-03 | Shawn sees low credits repeatedly | One unresolved top-up; cooldown/caps hold |
| CRE-04 | Usage permit replay/modified digest | No second debit/inference |
| CRE-05 | Top-up then consumption dashboard | No double-counted USDC expenditure |
| LLM-01 | Upstream timeout/price change/exhausted account | Fail closed or visible uncertain outcome; no uncontrolled retry |
| AGT-01 | Prince service choice | Useful brief and attributable purchased evidence |
| CNT-01 | Mira from approved handoff | Direct private devnet x402 signature, real inference, three editable posts and seven-day calendar |
| CNT-02 | Edit/approve/calendar change | No hidden charge or external publish |
| SEC-01 | Malicious service asks for funds/policy change | Independent rejection; no reliance on model refusal |
| SEC-02 | Prompt/log inspection | No secret notes, keys or sensitive auth material |
| BAK-01 | Restore backup with pending spend | No address reuse, duplicate purchase or lost change |
| LED-01 | Pending change and external recovery | Change unavailable before insertion; external recovered principal creates no pool note |
| EXIT-01 | Attacker signer with valid note proof | Derived label mismatch rejects; correct owner original/change exit succeeds |
| EXP-01 | Old proof in fresh-blockhash tx after bound | Clock/context check rejects; no premature reservation release |
| QUO-01 | Accepted tx settles after quote expires | Honor original price once; paid retries return cached result |
| QUO-02 | Re-quote funded operation | Existing funding reused/recovered; no second automatic withdrawal |
| USG-01 | Failure between scoped/account reservation | Reconcile same operation; no double debit or excess consumption |
| TIER-01 | Observe tier requests purchase | No spending proof/signature released |
| TIER-02 | Approval missing, changed or replayed | Reject; valid approval still cannot override hard caps |
| SESS-01 | Wallet challenge replay, wrong domain, expired session, CSRF | Reject unauthenticated mutations and session replay |
| AUTH-03 | Different workspace retrieves cached paid result | Reject cross-account access even with transaction signature |
| ISO-01 | Runner reads note/provider secrets or arbitrary signing endpoint | Process/credential isolation denies access |
| ART-01 | Proving/verifying artifact or manifest mismatch | Stop proof/payment generation |
| ADMIN-01 | Inspect deployed upgrade and approved-set authority | Separate public authority mapping matches manifest; powers disclosed |

## Recorded coverage

| Source | Observed scope | Status / limit |
|---|---|---|
| [M2 files](https://github.com/Seann004/Veilo-agent-wallet/blob/fe13778/artifacts/evidence/m2-summary.json) | Deploy, two deposits/inserts, approval, spend, change insert, Echo merchant and original/change exits | **verified on devnet**. PRIV-01/PRIV-07/EXIT happy paths only; no full negative matrix or agent control integration implied. |
| [Integration JSON](https://github.com/Seann004/Veilo-agent-wallet/blob/fe13778/artifacts/evidence/integration-2026-10-17T00-36-54-669Z.json) | 30/30 passed; IDEM-01, X402-03/04, REC-01/02/03, CRE-01/03, USG-01, LLM-01, QUO-01/02, LED-01, CAP-02, BAK-01, REV-01, SEC-02 | **verified on local test validator**; **fixture / mock provider**. X402-01 is partial: local chain and mock inference cannot meet its devnet/live-inference expectation. |
| [Build status](../build-status.md) T02–T14 and source tests | Unit/LiteSVM evidence for NET, CAP, AUTH, PRIV, EXP, EXIT, TIER, SESS, ISO, ART and runner/content cases | Historical local results only; not rerun in this documentation pass. Do not describe LiteSVM as a local test validator. |
| [Demo steps](../guide/demo.md) | Shawn top-up, Prince brief, Mira direct content payment, duplicate/cap/revoke/exit recording | Complete devnet acceptance evidence is missing here; local agent rehearsal uses a **fixture / mock provider**. A parallel branch’s gateway chain record alone does not complete the gate. Funded dashboard screenshots also outstanding. |

The integration report's `environment`, `prdCoverage`, `tests`, `failedOrSkipped` and `scenarioEvidence` are the machine-readable record. Its program hash identifies the tested binary, but it does not name the tested Git commit; attach that commit and reviewer at submission freeze. The separate OpenRouter smoke is a baseline, not AGT-01/CNT-01 completion. All remaining matrix rows lack a consolidated, reviewed per-case submission record.

## Evidence quality

Use real proof artifacts and the deployed verifier for privacy checks. Include positive and negative cases, concurrency tests and deterministic restart/fault injection. A transaction signature proves a public transaction; it does not independently prove policy enforcement or correct service delivery. Keep failures and skipped checks visible in the implementation's test report.

## Marketplace acceptance is separate

PRD v3.2 adds T17–T23 and fourteen §26.6 checks. The complete [marketplace acceptance matrix](../guide/marketplace-triage.md) assigns documentation IDs MKT-01–MKT-14, specifies closure evidence and records each as **not yet run for the marketplace**. It covers identity/tenant isolation, immutable seller quotes, concurrent hires, receipt uniqueness, failure recovery, refunds, leases, malicious files, offline control and unchanged pool invariants. These are requirement labels, not passing test names.

The 30-case local P0 report does not prove Supabase RLS/Storage, a seller job, cloud/local replay handling, earnings or a hosted sandbox. A free/fixture demonstration cannot satisfy genuine devnet seller settlement. Keep marketplace evidence separate from the existing P0/M2 records and attach the exact implemented commit, environment and actors.

## Diagram: architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  owner["Owner dashboard<br/>Create agents and set rules"]
  runner["Agent runner<br/>Propose a resource purchase"]
  control["Control service<br/>Check policy and reserve budget"]
  wallet["Wallet service<br/>Private notes, proofs and signing"]
  ledger[(Durable allowance ledger)]
  owner -->|job| runner
  owner -->|policy and approval| control
  runner -->|purchase request| control
  control -->|record reservation| ledger
  control -->|approved operation| wallet
```

## Diagram: private-funding

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  wallet["Local wallet service<br/>Generate a bound proof"]
  relay["Relayer and indexer<br/>Submit and track public state"]
  pool["Solana pool program<br/>Verify proof and spend note"]
  fresh["Fresh payment wallet<br/>Receive authorized test tokens"]
  merchant["Merchant token account<br/>Receive ordinary x402 payment"]
  wallet -->|withdrawal proof| relay
  relay --> pool
  pool -->|PDA vault payout| fresh
  fresh -->|facilitator-settled transfer| merchant
```

## Diagram: service-delivery

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  control["Owner control service<br/>Bound quote and operation"]
  gateway["Veilo service gateway<br/>Payment checks and result cache"]
  facilitator["x402 facilitator<br/>Verify and settle merchant payment"]
  credits[(Shared gateway credit ledger)]
  provider["OpenRouter or data adapter<br/>Bounded service delivery"]
  control -->|authenticated request| gateway
  gateway -->|payment payload| facilitator
  facilitator -->|settlement result| gateway
  gateway -->|credit pack or prepaid usage| credits
  gateway -->|operator-funded inference or data| provider
  gateway -->|result and status| control
```

## Diagram: payment

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor Owner
  participant Agent
  participant Control
  participant Wallet
  participant Pool as Relayer / Pool
  participant Gateway
  participant Facilitator
  participant Provider
  Owner->>Control: Activate bounded policy
  Agent->>Control: Request approved purchase
  Control->>Gateway: Stable operation and request digest
  Gateway-->>Control: Immutable bound quote
  Control->>Control: Atomically check caps and reserve
  Control->>Wallet: Authorized operation and policy epoch
  Wallet->>Wallet: Persist fresh signer, recheck policy, prove locally
  Wallet->>Pool: Release bound withdrawal proof
  Pool->>Pool: Verify, consume nullifier, fund fresh wallet, queue change
  Pool-->>Wallet: Finalized withdrawal
  Wallet->>Wallet: Recheck epoch and all merchant instructions
  Wallet->>Gateway: Submit bound x402 payment
  Gateway->>Gateway: Validate and claim operation / signature
  Gateway->>Facilitator: Settle exact merchant payment
  Facilitator-->>Gateway: Finalized settlement evidence
  Gateway->>Gateway: Persist one payment event
  alt Credit pack
    Gateway->>Gateway: Issue shared credits once
  else Direct inference purchase
    Gateway->>Provider: One bounded operator-funded attempt
    Provider-->>Gateway: Real output or uncertain outcome
    Gateway->>Gateway: Persist result or paid-without-result
  end
  Gateway-->>Control: Existing purchase status / result
  Control-->>Agent: Save output and attributed cost
  Note over Control,Gateway: Retry same operation: reconcile or return cache, never blindly pay again
```

## Diagram: marketplace

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  buyer["Buyer / owner agent<br/>Discover and propose a specialist"]
  cloud["Marketplace — planned<br/>Supabase identity, catalogue, jobs and private files"]
  control["Owner-local control<br/>Approve seller, check limits, reserve and reconcile"]
  wallet["Owner-local wallet<br/>Note secrets, proof and constrained signing"]
  pool["Existing Solana pool<br/>Proof-authorized fresh-wallet funding"]
  exact["Ordinary public x402 V2 exact<br/>Verified seller recipient"]
  seller["Reviewed seller runtime — planned<br/>Run only after verified finality or explicit free quote"]
  result["Private deliverable and finalized receipt<br/>One payment, one job, one earnings event"]
  buyer --> cloud
  control <-->|"Local control initiates outbound connection<br/>Authenticated, digest-bound, expiring requests"| cloud
  control -->|"Local authority only"| wallet
  wallet --> pool
  pool --> exact
  exact --> seller
  seller --> result
  result --> cloud
```
